> Remove an app from a site in the web UI, see why a bench is degraded, manage logs on a new Storage page, and install sendme automatically on first send or receive, plus three fixes for app updates, maintenance detection and serving benches.

### Upgrade Steps

* [ACTION REQUIRED] Install on 3.6.x or newer: run `sudo cwcli self-update` on a shared install or `cwcli self-update` on a per-user install; it upgrades cwcli and restarts the services that were running.
* [ACTION REQUIRED] Verify: run `cwcli --version` and check that it prints `3.9.0`.

### New Features

* The web UI can remove an app from a site: each installed app on the site page has a Remove app action that runs as a job, asks you to type the app name, and takes a verified backup of the site first unless you untick it.
* The web UI shows why a bench is degraded, so a degraded state names its reasons.
* A Storage page in the web UI lists and manages container, bench and journal logs.
* The web UI installs a pinned, verified sendme on first send or receive, with a progress bar. Backups > Receive no longer fails with "sendme is not installed".

### Bug Fixes

* An app update no longer fails because of an unreadable site unrelated to it. Such a site is reported as a warning and the sites that hold the app are updated normally.
* cwcli detects read-only maintenance mode on Frappe v16.61 and later, so a bench left in maintenance is found and offered for clearing again.
* A serving bench reloads after `new-site` or `init` installs apps. Before, the running web workers kept the old app set and the site returned HTTP 500 until the instance was restarted.

### Other Changes

* Remote machine groups are set apart from projects in the web UI sidebar.
